readings: Group the compliance cases by broker reporting status (`brokrepstat`), treating cases with no status as their own group, and find each status's average model confidence (`modelconf`). For the baseline, take the mean of those per-status averages, counting each status once no matter how many cases it has. Which statuses have an average above that baseline? For each, show the status, its average model confidence, its average minus the baseline, and its average divided by the mean of the qualifying statuses' averages. Averages ignore missing values. Return nothing if either reference value is missing. Don't round.
queries:
WITH status_averages AS (
    SELECT brokrepstat, AVG(modelconf) AS avg_modelconf
    FROM compliancecase
    GROUP BY brokrepstat
),
baseline AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_modelconf) AS baseline_avg
    FROM status_averages
),
qualifying AS (
    SELECT s.brokrepstat, s.avg_modelconf
    FROM status_averages AS s
    CROSS JOIN baseline AS b
    WHERE s.avg_modelconf > b.baseline_avg
),
qualifying_mean AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_modelconf) AS qualifying_avg
    FROM qualifying
)
SELECT
    q.brokrepstat,
    q.avg_modelconf,
    q.avg_modelconf - b.baseline_avg AS difference_from_baseline,
    q.avg_modelconf / m.qualifying_avg AS ratio_to_qualifying_mean
FROM qualifying AS q
CROSS JOIN baseline AS b
CROSS JOIN qualifying_mean AS m
WHERE b.baseline_avg IS NOT NULL
  AND m.qualifying_avg IS NOT NULL
